description: MainActivity.java is the core activity for an Android wearable app that manages connections with GoogleApiClient, handles data and message events from wearable data layer, manages UI components like a view pager with fragments, and interacts with wearable capabilities. It includes logic for handling data synchronization, displaying received images, and node capability discovery.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing wearable data synchronization, capabilities, and UI navigation.
